package.name: omx_vla_app
package.description:
VLA task tooling for the OMX follower, driven entirely over ROS.
Runs inside omx_bridge_image against its public interface: commands go out on /sync/command and the twin's state comes back on the profile's sim endpoint. The cube is read and moved through Isaac's own prim services, so an episode needs no Isaac-side scripting -- open the scene, press Play, ros2 run.
